items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I learned a lot from him, because I listened to him play.

items.title: 75230_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I met a piano player up there who was looking for a trumpet player... So he was working in St. Paul... I went over to St. Paul to work for him... Homer Woods.
